note: No record-class fact: the document describes SIPAO only as a sub-regional programme to increase information exchange and coordination between law-enforcement services (EU-funded, ending six months after the 6 June 2024 audience), and names CREDPOL without saying what it does or that stations enter cases in it; the ministry asked the CNT for legislation to sustain CREDPOL.
